# Barbara Shaw

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Barbara Shaw is a tall and awkward girl. She often gives the impression of having too many hands and feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Barbara Shaw is exceptionally clumsy, to the extent that her fellow scholars at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) mark the rare occasions when she manages to walk down the aisle without tripping over her own or someone else's feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Barbara Shaw moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to live with her aunt. She became one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later resigned her teaching position to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Barbara and her fellow students were left deeply sorrowful.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), +3 more_
